thread:
jordan: Heads-up — noticed three rollouts queued for the same change window (11:00 PST) and approvals are backing up. Anyone else seeing this?
elena: Yep, saw the queue. Canary + A/B split + feature-flag rollout all target the same window.
maya: Ugh. Deploy-bot processes approvals in series, so the later ones sit waiting. We should avoid exact same start times.
andre: +1. We could add jitter to start times or a small spacing heuristic so approvals/traffic-splits don't collide.
sre-oncall: If we auto-stagger, we should surface it in the console so PMs know their rollout may start ±N minutes. Risk: confusion about SLA for canaries.
jordan: Proposal: add optional "start_jitter_minutes" in the rollout config. When the rollout is scheduled, deploy-bot picks a random offset within that window and records the concrete start_ts. This keeps the change-window intact but spreads load/approvals.
maya: Example config stub:
```json
{
  "id":"r-321",
  "policy":{
    "canary":{"percent":5},
    "change_window":"2026-03-20T11:00:00-08:00",
    "start_jitter_minutes": 15
  }
}
```
andre: Also add a small deterministic backoff for approval retries, and an "approval_priority" tag (low/normal/high) so infra-critical rollouts can skip the jitter.
elena: We should emit telemetry: rollout_start_offset_minutes, rollout_overlap_flag, and a histogram of approval_queue_wait_seconds. Then add an eng-releases dashboard tile showing overlap_count over time.
sre-oncall: Another wrinkle: timezones. Some teams schedule "business hours" windows in local timezone—deploy-bot should normalize to UTC and compute jitter in UTC to avoid double-booking across regions.
deploy-bot: automated: noted — if config.start_jitter_minutes present, will sample offset in [0, start_jitter_minutes] at enqueue time and annotate rollout metadata with actual_start_ts.
ops-bot: created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/1428 "deploy-bot: start_jitter and overlap telemetry" and assigned to @jordan @andre @maya.
jordan: Cool. Next steps: I can draft a small PR to deploy-bot adding the jitter sampling + metadata and emit metric rollout_overlap_flag when two start_ts land within 5 minutes. Maya can sketch dashboard panels. Andre can review API change for approval_priority. Aim for the next minor deploy-window (next Tue).
maya: I can mock the Grafana panels today.
andre: I'll review the API/CLI changes. One note: ensure the console shows the final chosen start time in the rollout details so PMs/users see the real schedule.
elena: Also add a short note in the rollout UX that start times may vary when jitter enabled. Small copy change.
sre-oncall: If overlaps still happen, we can auto-extend guard.window by +10m for the later rollout and notify oncall. Keep me in the loop.
jordan: Thanks — I'll open the PR and link the issue. :thumbsup:
